newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission had designated, by consensus, Carlo Trojan to be the new Secretary General in replacement of David Williamson. Vale de Almeida said Trojan would start his new job on August 1, 1997.
Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on Wednesday's Internal Market Council.

Spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission had agreed the text of the negotiations to join the Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) and that the proposal would be sent to the Council for approval. Guilford said this agreement had an enormous political and financial significance. "It shows for the first time that we do not only have a commercial interest in East-Asia but a strategic interest to promote decent security there," he said.

Asked why, instead of spending ECU 75 million on KEDO, the Commission did not decide to spend that sum to help resolve the famine in North Korea, Vale de Almeida said an additional project was being finalized and might be presented on Friday.
Guilford also said the final round of negotiations on a Mutual Recognition Agreement was taking place in Washington.

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had numerous reasons to believe the chances of success of the Amsterdam inter-governmental conference were high and that expected results would be achieved.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/423: Lawyers: Commissioner Monti welcomes Council agreement on directive.
- IP/97/427: Wildlife trade: Commissioner Bjerregaard welcomes information campaign.
- IP/97/428: EU to join North Korea nuclear security body.
- IP/97/429: Kaleidoscope Programme 1997: Support for Cultural co-operation projects in the EU.
- IP/97/430: State aid: Germany - Aid in favour of SKET Schwermaschinenbau Magdeburg GmbH (SMM), Saxony-Anhalt.
- Speech/97/114: Speech by Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard on sustainable management of forests and derivative products in Europe and the rest of the world.
- Speech/97/115: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn at EU/U.S. workshop on employment policy and the promotion of employability security.
- Memo/97/52: Dairy sector - situation and outlook.
